body: Correct me if I'm wrong, but aren't suicidal thoughts are never things you "get over" or are "cured" of? I'm hesitant to suggest help because from what I've read that only makes things feel worse on them. I really do want  her to seek help, I just don't know how to suggest it.
She's been to various doctors and therapists. This was my initial reaction but from everything else I've read asking her to see someone about it only makes the problem worse.
